host_family: GitHub Copilot; distinct CLI, SDK consumer, VS Code extension, chat MCP App, and canvas surfaces
current_account_readiness: Root observed the visible task-profile paint-workspace window in Restricted Mode, with Models unavailable and Sign In visible. Human workspace-trust review and GitHub sign-in are pending; no authentication automation or model call was performed.
filesystem_boundary: Task-scoped arguments are not strict filesystem isolation: root observed automatic VS Code sharedStorage/state.vscdb creation under the user .vscode-shared directory. It was not read, deleted, or edited by the agent.

features.surface: CLI runtime with SDK consumer callback
features.offering: Boolean confirmation
features.evidence: Fresh accept=true, decline=false, cancel=false; no model call.
features.limit: A supplied callback is not a terminal painter.

features.surface: CLI runtime with SDK consumer callback
features.offering: Choice and constrained text input
features.evidence: Beta and synthetic returned; cancel/decline returned null. Input maxLength=12 reached the callback schema.
features.limit: Validation/schema transport is distinct from real focus, keyboard or paint.

features.offering: Negotiated elicitation gate
features.evidence: Bare ui.elicitation=false; confirm refused. Explicit callback advertises elicitation=true.
features.limit: No-renderer result does not exclude native Copilot UI.

features.offering: Confirm, select, input and Escape
features.evidence: Four dialogs passed in the prior 1.0.103 cohort, zero inference.
features.limit: Not repeated in this study; terminal GUI remains under foreground/tool constraints.

features.offering: Session-aware JavaScript tools and slash commands
features.layer: official extension contract and current help
features.evidence: Experimental; repository, personal or plugin scope.
features.limit: Separate from retired GitHub App integrations and IDE extensions.

features.offering: Tool, path, URL and sandbox controls
features.evidence: Availability filters and approval rules differ; deny rules take precedence.
features.limit: No permission UI or OS effect tested in this cohort.

features.offering: Resume, fork, usage, theme and statusline commands
features.evidence: Commands are present in current help.
features.limit: No private session history or effective terminal theme was inspected.

features.offering: Experimental MCP Apps opt-in
features.evidence: enableMcpApps and runtime feature gate are separate requirements; consumer must have an iframe renderer.
features.limit: Bare-consumer mcpApps=false is not a global product exclusion; opt-in paint is untested.

features.offering: Image input and embedded context negotiation
features.evidence: CLI 1.0.103 reports image=true, audio=false, embeddedContext=true.
features.limit: Input capability does not establish image output or interactive canvas.

features.offering: Exact negative method probe
features.evidence: Invented ui/show rejected with -32601.
features.limit: Only this method was rejected; other UI routes remain separate.

features.offering: Inline HTML forms, dashboards and visualizations
features.layer: official host contract; current paint pending
features.evidence: Tool metadata identifies ui:// HTML resource, bridged from a sandboxed iframe.
features.limit: Account, trust, capabilities and actual paint still require named-host verification.

features.offering: Server tools, drafted follow-up and context attachment
features.evidence: sendMessage drafts chat input; context updates appear as attachments.
features.limit: Neither drafts nor direct controls imply another inference turn.

features.offering: Bounded mode and device support
features.evidence: Inline only; fullscreen, PiP, camera, microphone and geolocation excluded. Clipboard write is supported.
features.limit: Do not transfer these exclusions to ordinary webviews or other hosts.

features.offering: Sandbox and explicit CSP origins
features.evidence: Declare connection, resource and embedded-frame origins; negotiate optional features.
features.limit: Current resource reachability is not iframe-paint acceptance.

features.offering: Custom editor document and message bridge
features.layer: fresh real VS Code 1.143.1 extension host
features.evidence: Button action changed7 to8; unsupported action refused; disposal callback fired. Eight checks include runtime inventory.
features.limit: Copilot extension metadata was null in this test runtime; this is not Copilot Chat rendering.

features.offering: Script opt-in, CSP and resource boundaries
features.evidence: Default scripts emitted zero messages; unapproved script denied; top DOM SecurityError; no require/process.
features.limit: Immediate wrapper access differs from top-application access.

features.offering: JSON state and serializer-based restoration
features.layer: fresh content-reload/new-panel checks; documented broader persistence
features.evidence: State7 survived content reload; a new panel did not inherit disposed-panel state.
features.limit: Hidden-tab lifecycle/restart serializer behavior remains untested; retainContextWhenHidden has memory cost.

features.offering: Theme classes, CSS variables and accessibility cues
features.layer: fresh active-theme inspection; other modes untested
features.evidence: lang=en, vscode-dark and injected editorForeground #bbbebf observed.
features.limit: No light/high-contrast/reduced-motion switch tested; host variables are not exact ColorSet claims.

features.offering: Quick picks, input boxes, notifications, trees and status items
features.evidence: Native extension surfaces complement panels, custom editors and webview views.
features.limit: An MCP tool alone does not grant the VS Code extension API.

features.offering: Extension-contributed and MCP tools
features.evidence: Contribute/register tools and meaningful confirmation messages; availability depends on harness and configuration.
features.limit: A tool contribution is not an arbitrary chat DOM insertion API.

features.surface: Local Copilot Agent Host on VS Code desktop
features.offering: Preview canvas extensions with agent-callable actions
features.evidence: Enable chat.canvases.enabled and use an installed canvas extension in a supported session.
features.limit: Excludes Claude, Codex, extension-host Local, remote Agent Host, web and auxiliary-window hosting.

features.offering: Shared side-panel canvases and extension-managed artifacts
features.evidence: Humans and agent actions share the work surface; plugins can distribute canvases.
features.limit: Persistence depends on extension state/artifacts; no app canvas paint was tested here.
